patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/87b096d573c175653a3b7b3c2342b9e60fa63c4f.png Greetings Terrarians! ​ So, 1.4.5.7 is out for PC, coming very soon for Console and Mobile - how exciting! We hope you all enjoy what is on offer with this latest Terraria update. The next few steps in our journey are pretty exciting, and we cannot wait to share all of that with you in the months ahead. For now, we have left a few hints in this month's developer update sections. We are currently on the road at Gamescom with the majority of Team Terraria and that has been equal parts productive and ridiculously fun. We will share more about our travels later on. All that said, let's cover what has been going on over the past month and a tease for what lies ahead, shall we? On with the show! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 - RELEASED LAST WEEK FOR PC We hope that everyone has been enjoying what Terraria 1.4.5.7 has to offer over the past week or so. As we mentioned previously, we will be watching feedback closely to see what tweaks might need to be made in addition to a few other tidbits that we still want to address in future updates. In case you missed it for some reason, the link to the changelog thread is below. TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 CHANGELOG {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png CROSSPLAY IS ON DECK! In case you need a refresher about how Terraria Crossplay will roll out - namely, in two distinct phases - we have included a link to that summary from DR Studios below: CROSSPLAY ROLLOUT PLAN - FROM FEBRUARY 2026 STATE OF THE GAME We cannot wait for Terraria to enter the Crossplay era at long last! patches.title: Terraria 1.4.5.7 - Out Now for PC! (Console/Mobile Soon)
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/d8e64fccf4c6a6ba668db850bbb0e6be7de5d0ac.png Greetings Terrarians! At long last, we are pleased to announce that Terraria 1.4.5.7 is out now for PC! Terraria 1.4.5.7 is the latest and last (barring any critical fixes needed) hotfix for the Bigger and Boulder update. It has a heavy focus on balance, including stat and functionality changes to existing items and even some brand new items that we are sure you will all enjoy. Of course, while we were at it, we dealt with some outstanding bugs and more. We decided to post this update separately vs with all of the other hotfixes given its scope. We had originally planned to sync this release across PC-Mobile-Console, but with Gamescom coming up next week (more on that below), we had to make the call to get PC out now and then get Console and Mobile into submissions immediately. This allows us to have the update out, time for any critical fixes, and then the submissions can run their course in parallel. Mobile and Console will release just as soon as those submissions clear. What's next? Again, barring any critical fixes that would necessitate a 1.4.5.8, next up should be the long-awaited Crossplay Phase One update (1.4.6)! We will have more on what all that entails in the near future, though you can check previous State of the Game posts for some advance hints and how Phase One and Phase Two will roll out. In addition, the Re-Logic and DR Studios teams will be holding joint planning sessions next week at Gamescom in order to lay out the path forward for future Terraria updates. We will share the results of those meetings at a later time. All that said, let's dive into the what's new and the changelog, shall we? TERRARIA DEDICATED SERVER - 1.4.5.8 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/faf9b06e0f48a651389b7c8b077f1b576c6b896f.png TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 CHANGELOG​ I. patches.title: Terraria State of the Game - July 2026
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/82b1363c400bdeb3a62293e007e5ef8c5bd71192.png Greetings Terrarians! Hot enough for you out there? The way we figure it, there is no better way to dodge these insane heatwaves than getting some game time. Of course, we remain hard at work on the latest update (1.4.5.7) as well as laying the groundwork for what is to come soon thereafter. Parts of the team are also gearing up for some upcoming travel. It is an exciting time for Terraria and our team, and we cannot wait to share that journey with all of you in the coming months. For now, we will just leave the details as a mystery! Let's dive right into the latest Terraria news... {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 - THE FINAL PUSH Terraria 1.4.5.7 is nearing completion at last! We expect to have development work wrapped up shortly, and then we just have to do a localization pass (getting the various translations and adding them in) and the latest Terraria update will be ready for submissions. Once it clears submissions (as with 1.4.5, we are aiming for a sync launch across PC/Console/Mobile), you will finally have access to all of the new goodies and balance tweaks. Of course, we expect that there will be more feedback in regards to the balance changes (it is impossible to ever get it perfectly right in one go) - the plan is to roll any additional tweaks from that feedback into the next update (currently expected to be Crossplay Phase One). This one has taken a good while, but we are excited for what is to come your way very soon. In August, we will be getting together in person with our good friends at DR Studios for some planning and roadmap work - setting the path in place for future Terraria updates. We will share some pics and details from those sessions in a future State of the Game. All that said, shall we check out a little spoiler? {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/51cf21547a2998e834c44181ac910e1048a20123.gif The Chlorophyte Claymore - when you need to clear a room fast, accept no substitute... Keep your thoughts and feedback rolling in - Terraria 1.4.5.7 will be with you soon! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/3c24853f896391b...

patches.title: Terraria State of the Game - June 2026
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/2f6e99310e5a140132376f7f33963677ab2917c9.jpg Greetings Terrarians! Another month in the books! It has been a hectic one indeed, between work on 1.4.5.7, doing some interviews for the Design Works book, getting ready for some upcoming events in the fall, and more. We are very ready to get what we hope will be the last (or darn close to it) hotfix update for Bigger and Boulder into your hands and then to get rolling on what comes next. Crossplay and beyond, the future is going to be a fun one. Before then, we are getting ever closer to wrapping up what has to be the largest "hotfix" type update in Terraria's history. We do think the time taken will be well worth it, as we are trying to tackle a number of outstanding topics at once. Of course, we will see what you make of it and cannot wait to hear that feedback. All that said, let's see what lies in wait for this months State of the Game... {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 - THROWING LINES... WITH STYLE The balance train continues unabated yet again this month. We have spent a lot of time this go-round looking into entire classes of weapons - making sure things feel fun, relevant, and worthwhile. All of this has taken place alongside some backend/system work that should improve the overall experience. The rollout plan for Crossplay (post 1.4.5.7) is in place as well. Beyond that, we are setting up some important planning sessions with our friends at DR Studios so that we can lay out the internal roadmap for what comes next. If all goes to plan, what we come up with there should flow seamlessly into development work right after Crossplay. As for what the plan might entail? Well, you will have to wait and see there. As for this month's spoiler... a little while back, our good friend Chippy pointed out that yo-yo's might have been left behind a touch through the years. We've seen this feedback before and have decided to go ahead and finally take action on it. We're looking into making some yo-yo's more interesting / unique. it. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/b8304716355d9eb75105de875e6db2d38d18c6a2.gif Cascade's got a little ...

patches.title: Terraria: Design Works - Preorder yours today!
patches.content: TERRARIA: DESIGN WORKS {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/a976cf93cd75c042c57fa321a461b61cb024aa44.jpg This premium book will chart the design and development of Terraria from its inception back in 2011 through to today, written by Christian Donlan. Now you can dig into the game’s development itself with Terraria: Design Works. Based on in-depth interviews with Andrew Spinks, the singular individual who created Terraria, along with the fascinating team who have worked with him to keep the game thriving for the last fifteen years, this is the story of a game developed with passion, ingenuity, imagination and generosity. It’s easy to lose yourself in Terraria when playing, and now you’ll discover the challenges of charting a development course through such a rich, sprawling, and surprising game. You’ll meet the people who have worked with Spinks to evolve his original design, and you’ll come to understand where many of Terraria’s legendary elements come from, whether that’s a biome, an end-game monster or just a really cool sword! Packed with behind the scene insights, developer interviews and never seen before content, the book is available standalone or as part of a Deluxe Edition complete with a treasure trove of Terraria goodies. patches.title: Terraria 15th Anniversary Collector's Edition - Preorders are now open!
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/4fb7256abf386d0b442240450d42d5a3548af554.png Greetings, Terrarians! As we mentioned in our 15th Anniversary post a few weeks ago, we are beyond excited to roll out a brand new Terraria Collector's Edition. We think this is a nice handful of really cool collectables that the fans will enjoy. Anyway, let's jump right in to the details, shall we? Check out a quick video preview of the Terraria 15th Anniversary Collector's Edition! So, what all is included? TERRARIAN HERO FIGURINE Recreating Terraria’s iconic box art, this stunning figurine diorama stands just over 6 inches tall. This proud Terrarian hero strides forth into the depths in search of adventure, fortune, and certain death! --- LIFE CRYSTAL Ahh, the hours spent digging around for these little beauties. Permanently level up your life with your very own Life Crystal! Suspended on a removable stand, this hefty heart is the perfect keepsake for any desk or shelf. --- LENTICULAR PIXEL ART CARD SET Exquisite pixel art collectible cards with lenticular animation. --- RE-GAME CARTRIDGE “And now for something completely different.” Immortalise your own copy of Terraria with this awesome retro replica. This replica game cartridge houses a beautifully detailed Terraria game token, upon which a Steam key for Terraria will be engraved. The ultimate collectible and display piece for your favourite game. --- LETTER FROM RED To cap things off, we have a lovely little letter from Terraria’s legendary creator, Andrew Spinks, a.k.a. Redigit. The letter is adorned with gold foil edges and a Terraria logo seal. Yours to cherish. --- Of course, no Terraria Collector's Edition would be complete without the Bunny Pet, so that will be included as well. We have really enjoyed working on this project with the fine folks over at GLO (the terraria.shop people) and we hope that you find the final package to be as cool as we do. If you want to learn more or place your preorder, simply click the link below or the banner image at the top of this post. TERRARIA 15TH ANNIVERSARY COLLECTOR'S EDITION Thanks for an amazing 15 years!!!​

patches.title: Terraria State of the Game - May 2026
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/1e98b5c18c13a38557e2dda5d1ce71d9e6d2ac41.png Greetings Terrarians! We are back once again with the latest and greatest Terraria news. It was another eventful month - Terraria turned 15(!), we saw the teaser reveals of both the Collector's Edition and the Design Works retrospective book, and a ton of progress took place on 1.4.5.7 as well. That one is shaping up nicely, we think, and thank you for giving us the time needed to try and get it as right as possible on the first go - a big challenge with any balance-based task. All that said, we hope you will enjoy what we have to share this month and are as excited as we are for what is to come in the weeks and months ahead! Let's see what is in store this month, shall we... {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 - GETTING OUTSIDE THE BOX Sometimes, addressing balance means rethinking some core aspects around how things function - or expanding upon what is already there in new ways. Our pair of spoilers this month are a nice representation of this dynamic. They are also again indicative of the scope of changes being made around the balancing goals - this is not just about adjusting a few numbers here and there. Of course, when the time comes and you all have these changes in your hands, we will be all ears to hear your feedback. Too much? Not enough? Just right? We can't wait to see what you make of it all! Alongside that work, we have been having some nice discussions around how best to roll out Crossplay (likely in phases, as shared previously) in a way that brings the functionality as quickly as possible to everyone without causing any confusion. We will share more on that as those plans coalesce, but suffice to say for now that we are trying to plan ahead for what's next! As for this month's PC spoiler, well... {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/dcab2223831846f90ae315aa2fd123e8b630775c.gif Where does he get those wonderful toys... Keep your thoughts and feedback rolling in, it is always helpful for us to take into account. Hopefully, we will have 1.4.5.7 wrapped up soon! {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/3c24853f896391bff2d39309d74b489d23...

patches.title: Celebrating 15 Years of Terraria!
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/663329026d95b0bf35381bea50fc6fed07eef136.png Fifteen Years?! That is a long time indeed! That's 131,400 hours - which quite a few of you have chosen to spend with our humble game. To say that reaching this milestone is equal parts insane and humbling is a massive understatement. It is really hard to put into words what your support for these many years has meant to our little studio. Simply put, you all are the engine that makes this all work. Your support allows us to keep going, keep expanding upon Terraria, without having to fall back to price increases or microtransactions. This is becoming increasingly rare in modern gaming, and we cannot thank you enough for making what we do every day possible. From the hardcore players with thousands of hours to those just discovering our "metroidvania in a sandbox" today... from the builders to the speedrunners... from those that we interact with regularly in our community to those that just enjoy the game in silence... from those that are regular Terraria enjoyers to those that like to shake things up with all sorts of mods on tModloader... each and every one of you are precious to us. We hope that our game has brought you some joy over the years. Terraria is a unique experience one that we like to think that we have shaped together alongside the fans into the awesomeness that it is today. This is as much your journey as it is ours! We thought that it might be fun to toss out some quick numbers to mark the occasion... Copies of Terraria sold to-date: Total: 70 Million PC: 39.6m Console: 10.7m Mobile: 19.7m tModLoader: 12.3m downloads on Steam Average Players/Day in the past year (PC) Terraria: 461k (peaked at 1.4m) tModLoader: 237k (peaked at 441k) (Steam counts Terraria and TML separately) Average Hours Played (PC): Terraria: 101 Hours, 18 Minutes tModLoader: 89 Hours, 52 Minutes How about you - how many hours have you played? When did you start? What is your favorite memory of your time with Terraria? {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/3c24853f896391bff2d39309d74b489d2394da30.png So, where does the path lead from here? patches.title: Terraria State of the Game - April 2026
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/80e58e939bf62e331ac0fa68e405305a119c1e18.png Greetings Terrarians! How in the world is it almost Summer already?! It feels like 1.4.5 launch was just yesterday... Our team has been head-down working away on post launch support for 1.4.5 and we really think everyone is going to enjoy what is coming soon in Terraria 1.4.5.7. You will get to see a bit more of that in the update sections below in this State of the Game. As it is balance focused, we are certain there will need to be some tweaks in what we assume will be 1.4.5.8 before we can hopefully - at long last - call 1.4.5 done and move on to the wonderful world of Crossplay. We received our Terraria Board Game copies as well, but we haven't really had time to dive in yet. There is so much more in the works for this year, it should be a fun ride! Shall we jump right in and see what this month's SOTG has in store? {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5.7 - POLISHING THE ROUGH EDGES AND SOME NEW TOYS As mentioned previously, for 1.4.5.7, balance is the name of the game. What sorts of things have we been looking into, you might wonder... well, for example, we've added some new tools to handle frustrations in combat (aggro, invisible hitboxes, ranges, boss attacks, following on Gastropods shooting you offscreen, for example). We're also giving some less popular items fresh new life, and adding new items for niche playstyles. Of course, there are other places we are exploring, but that gives you a flavor for the scope of what 1.4.5.7 is tackling - and why its taking a good bit longer than the other 1.4.5.X fixes. In the process of our balance work, we have lots of deep and winding discussions about various issues and how best to tackle them. Those discussions spark a lot of other discussions, which lead to things like what we wanted to share with you this month... {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0975e6a538ad593f3834be149cd31352b3b75ac1.gif A fun new minion for Summoners that don't mind getting their hands dirty... Keep your thoughts and feedback rolling in, it is always helpful for us to take into account. Hopefully, we will have 1.4...

patches.title: Terraria State of the Game: March 2026
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/39f237061b5366009e623786c9d7cfac7290e251.png Greetings Terrarians! Spring is finally here - we think - sort of? Seriously, last week we had both 80F days and a day of snow. Come on nature, make up your mind! On a serious note, work on 1.4.5.7 continues unabated. As we mentioned previously, this post launch fix update is heavily focused on balance. Console and Mobile continue to chase right behind while preparing for Crossplay. The Terraria Board Game Kickstarter copies are finally hitting the hands of players (exciting!). It really has been an eventful month - and year - so far, with so much more to come. With all that being said, shall we dive into the details? What lies in wait for Terrarians everywhere this month? {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5 - A DELICATE BALANCING ACT INDEED! March saw the release of 1.4.5.6 for PC. This was mostly a bug/exploit-focused hotfix, with only a few additions that were mostly related to localization feedback. We know it was hard to follow the act that was 1.4.5.5's dash button, but bug fixes are important too! We can certainly see the light at the end of the tunnel at this point, we hope. We also know that 1.4.5.7 will be a bit of a different and more difficult beast to tackle. If you missed any of the hotfixes thus far, you can find those changelogs here: TERRARIA 1.4.5: BIGGER & BOULDER CHANGELOGS As mentioned previously, for 1.4.5.7, the team has been hard at work under the hood since then focusing mostly on balance. To remind everyone of our philosophy going into that work, we wanted to re-share the below from our earlier "Status Update" post: We're already looking into some adjustments based on the feedback shared from everyone. It's too early to share anything - but we're cooking. This includes looking at individual items as well as the performance of the various classes in the game. It isn't a feasible goal for every class to have exactly the same performance given their different tradeoffs, but we do want to be sure that every class feels viable, fun, and at least in the same ballpark power-wise at similar skill levels. patches.title: Wave 2 of Terraria Chibichans - Preorders open until April 17
patches.content: Just before the end of 2025, we started taking preorders for the second series of Terraria Chibichans. We wanted to share that the preorder window will be closing on April 17th, 2026. Series Two features the Jungle Biome, with appearances by the Zoologist, Witch Doctor, Bee Armor, and more. If you order yours during the preorder phase, you will also receive an exclusive Doctor Bones Chibichan absolutely free! While Series Two figures will remain available on Terraria.shop past the preorder phase, this will be your only chance to pick up the exclusive Doctor Bones Chibichan for free. patches.title: Terraria State of the Game - February 2026
patches.content: {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/32d48ba5ac6ec95d206d7f2ba238a1157064b820.png Greetings Terrarians! After a brief hiatus - because the State of the Game last month should have been pretty obvious haha - we are back again with the usual monthly update across the world of Terraria. What a time it has been since our last SOTG - Terraria 1.4.5 released and has seen several rounds of fixes already (with more to come), a handful of new merch products released (details on that below), and planning is well underway for "what comes next". We will be hitting on all of those topics alongside our usual community pieces this month. Before we launch into all of that, we wanted to thank everyone for the overwhelming response to Terraria 1.4.5 and for your diligent reporting, feedback, and more as we go through our usual post-launch fixes and tweaks. You have once again proven that the Terraria fans are the best fans across all of gaming. What a great start to the year - shall we take a peek at what's to come? {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3949769/0fafbfc560bf0a25fbfca5b645c7c5e3f66ac51b.png PC - RE-LOGIC TERRARIA 1.4.5 - KICKING OFF 2026 IN STYLE! Well, we certainly kicked off 2026 with a bang, didn't we? Terraria 1.4.5: Bigger & Boulder released on January 27 across the globe and across all platforms and received a truly outstanding reception. We saw one of the largest player spikes in the history of the game (nearly twice the size of Labor of Love), peaking out at almost 230,000 concurrent players. To say that we are blown away once again by how you support our game and our team is the understatement of all time. Thank you a million times over! Of course, no update has been or ever will be perfect on launch. No matter how much we test things (and we do), releasing an update out to millions of players will bring forth bugs and issues that the team did not find or anticipate. Such was the case with 1.4.5 - but also as usual, you all have been amazing with your detailed bug reports and feedback rounds. This allowed us to release several hotfix rounds (five as of this writing), and we still have some more things we want to address before we will feel comfortable calling 1.4.5 done. If you missed...
